audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10 against a 50.89% win rate over 1678 games is right for a matchup Aurora wins on lane fundamentals but loses on scaling dive threat: Five Point Strike is 550 range and 110 mana at rank 1 against Aurora's 900-range Q, so lane is Aurora's, while Perfect Execution at 60s rank 3 out-tempos Aurora's 100s R in side lane and teamfights.

Level 6 correctly flips to Akali (Perfect Execution 120/90/60, execute recast) while every other row stays Skill. First item and 2+ items sit with Aurora's rotation. The spike array names the real 16s Shuriken Flip and the 60s rank-3 R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page covers Twilight Shroud unselectability and the R execute but never states Assassin's Mark — the auto-attack reset that actually opens her combo.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: spell damage rings the target, and exiting the ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage. That empowered auto is the visible wind-up before the burst, so it is the cue to hop, not the R cast. Note also Twilight Shroud carries revealsStealth — Aurora's Across the Veil invisibility is not a hiding place inside her smoke.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid now keys the post-6 read to the Assassin's Mark wind-up.
